name: o-json: drill into a record detail

actions.label: Return to the enclosing record
actions.caption: l l selects customer and enter opens it; backspace returns to the order. Follow a nested object and keep your route back.

actions.label: Rename a field in detail
actions.caption: K opens the selected key for renaming. Type order_id and enter to clarify this record without editing its value.

actions.label: Copy the selected detail cell
actions.caption: y copies the selected cell in this detail table. Reuse a displayed field label or value without taking the whole record.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
